dfx.example.goal: private equity buyers for a company from search results

annotations.title: Private equity firms that could buy this company

description: Computed buyer_for_company matches from the private equity matcher for one company (a dfx:pe:, dfx:isi: or dfx:vc: company id): each firm with the matcher's reasons, blockers, why_now and comparable transactions verbatim, the deal partner where attributed, score, confidence, model version and computed date. When the matcher has scored nothing for the company the answer is NOT_COVERED with the population count: that means DFX has not computed buyers for it, never that no buyer exists. For sponsors, family offices and capital providers as well, use find_capital_for_opportunity.
